function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what you’re looking for: | Option | What it offers | How to order | |--------|----------------|--------------| | **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, custom designs, same‑day options | • **Etsy** – search “custom cakes” and choose a local shop that ships to your area.
• **Goldbelly** – specialty cakes from famous bakeries across the U.S. (great for unique flavors).
• **Blue Apron** or **HelloFresh** – some meal‑kit companies offer cake kits you can bake at home. | | **Local bakeries with online ordering** | Fresh, often handmade, personalized messages | • Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp.
• Many bakeries now have their own websites or use platforms like **Square Online** or **Shopify** for orders.
• Call ahead if you need a specific flavor or size. | | **Grocery stores with bakery sections** | Convenient, same‑day pickup or delivery | • **Whole Foods**, **Trader Joe’s**, **Kroger**, **Safeway** – most have a bakery section and offer online ordering through their apps.
• Use the store’s website or app to place an order for pickup or delivery. | | **Specialty cake shops** | Custom wedding cakes, themed cakes, vegan/gluten‑free options | • **Cake Boss** (online ordering for custom cakes).
• **The Cake Shop** (specialty cakes, often with a local presence). | | **Food delivery apps** | Same‑day delivery, quick pick‑ups | • **Uber Eats**, **DoorDash**, **Grubhub** – many local bakeries partner with these services. Search “cakes” or “bakeries” in the app. | | **DIY cake kits** | Fun, hands‑on experience | • **Amazon** or **Walmart** – look for “cake baking kit” or “birthday cake kit.”
• **Baker’s Dozen** – offers pre‑measured ingredients and step‑by‑step instructions. | ### Quick Steps to Order 1. **Decide on the occasion** (birthday, wedding, corporate event, etc.). 2. **Choose a style** (classic vanilla, chocolate, vegan, gluten‑free, custom design). 3. **Pick a delivery method** (same‑day, next‑day, or pickup). 4. **Place the order** via the chosen platform (website, app, or phone call). 5. **Confirm details** (size, flavor, message, delivery time). If you let me know your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local options for you!
